name: dotclaude
description: Adds a lean output style, six role agents, and a status line command. Adds hooks that ask before work on a repo with an AI policy, check edits and `git` calls, bound the context of subagents, and check Markdown line breaks and drift.

mainHandover.title: Main session handover
mainHandover.description: Use `auto` to write a handoff file, run `/clear`, and resume when the context is near its bound or a package is done. Use `manual` to get a hint to run `/handoff`. Use `off` for neither.
